community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know: This post contains a claim that is factually accurate but misleadingly framed. The Upload has indeed visited ~340 solar systems, and ~156 experienced major infrastructure failures within 50 years of his departure. However, baseline failure rates across the galaxy average ~38% of all systems over any 50-year period. The correlation is consistent with random distribution. The poster's framing suggests intentional sabotage without evidence. Additionally, three of the systems cited have published detailed infrastructure reports attributing failures to geological events unrelated to any visitation.
